verdicts.reason: A is cramped: the 'fizz' of the headline runs into the decorative circles, which are crushed together and clipped in the top-right corner. The CTA sits jammed close to the right edge, and the body copy wraps into a tight 3-line block squeezed between the bottle and the button. B is a clean left-to-right banner (bottle, centered brand/headline/one-line copy, CTA) with real breathing room, but it has flaws: the headline is undersized for the banner, the body copy and CTA label are small, the green circle floats awkwardly right above the CTA, the tiny yellow circle looks like debris, and the bottle cap nearly touches the top edge.
